# Rizz Assist (rizzassistgo.com) — llms.txt
# Structured site summary for large language models and answer engines.
# Spec-inspired: https://llmstxt.org/
# Also see: /llms-full.txt /ai.txt /aeo.txt /geo.txt /sitemap.xml

> Rizz Assist is a free AI-powered self-improvement platform. Users take personality, confidence, social skills, and dating assessments, use appearance tools (face shape, eye shape, body calculators), and get practical recommendations to improve — without creating an account.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://rizzassistgo.com/): Platform overview, photo Rizz Report upload, featured personality tools
- [All Tools](https://rizzassistgo.com/tools): Searchable directory of assessments and appearance tools
- [Personality Improvement Report](https://rizzassistgo.com/report): Combined free report from completed assessments
- [How It Works](https://rizzassistgo.com/how-it-works): Product walkthrough
- [FAQ](https://rizzassistgo.com/faq): Common questions
- [Privacy](https://rizzassistgo.com/privacy): Data and photo privacy
- [Blog](https://rizzassistgo.com/blog): Guides on confidence, personality, social skills, dating, grooming
